source: Direção-Geral do Território (DGT), public LiDAR viewer
attribution: Source © Direção-Geral do Território, CC BY 4.0. Locally derived images and ground model.
referenceScope: Inspired by image-based terrain screening. Article does not publish patch dimensions or overlap; these parameters are our own. No feature labels or discovery claims.
terrainMethod: Class 2 ground mean per 0.5 m cell; source model uses 0.25 m Gaussian smoothing, nearest gap support up to 5 m, CAOP2025 mask; centimetre-quantized stored tiles. No additional terrain smoothing here.
derivatives: North-up ENU central differences at 0.5 m. Derivatives require valid immediate neighbours; otherwise dark NoData. Hillshades use ambient 0.15, direct 0.85, sun altitude 35 degrees, no exaggeration. All layers calculated over a 32 m halo before pixel-aligned cropping.
localRelief: Terrain minus normalized separable Gaussian (sigma 10 m, radius 30 m); ignores missing cells and restores original validity. Common colour range +/-2 m.
supportMask: 0 invalid model; 1 valid model with at least one raw ground return in cell; 2 valid model without raw returns in cell. Measured cells still contain smoothed model values. Counts use all cached hierarchy levels and the same per-source 1 km footprint as model construction.
overlapWarning: Overlapping crops are not independent samples. For training/evaluation split by non-overlapping spatial blocks, not random patch IDs.
